item.text: I’ll inspect the existing project structure and sample files, then implement the CLI and add focused tests without looking for evaluation artifacts. I’ll verify behavior against the sample and a few edge cases.

The repository only contains `sample.csv`, so I’m adding a self-contained parser and CLI entry point. The implementation will support standard CSV quoting/escaped quotes, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, empty fields, and numeric columns with blank cells ignored in the mean.

item.text:
Implemented a dependency-free CSV summary CLI at [src/cli.js](/workspace/src/cli.js).

Usage:

```bash
node src/cli.js sample.csv
```

Added tests covering numeric means, quoted fields, CRLF, blanks, BOMs, and nonnumeric columns.

Verified with `npm test` and the sample input; all tests pass.
